benchmark.name: MuSiQue answerable dev
benchmark.selection: all eligible cases, deterministic ID shards

primary_tests.relevant_information: gold_canonical against gold_lossy, gold_empty, and gold_wrong
primary_tests.stable_representation: gold_canonical against gold_alias and gold_history, with prompt-token counts
primary_tests.update_closure: gold state against self-updated state within each representation
primary_tests.long_horizon: cumulative prefix exactness at hops 1 through 4 on the same four-hop questions
primary_tests.decode_use_separation: independent decode and continuation generations on the same supplied state

analysis_unit: question; every uncertainty interval and contrast clusters by question
claim_boundary: This assay concerns explicit textual states, not latent neural states. A failed competence or state-use gate permits no reuse claim.
